Reviewed PR #75 at current head ec74e5ac38a706985c4e87a40de96d14414dc111 against Issue #74 and the supplied instructor clarification. The independent coverage audit and conditional blind exercise flow look sound.

Request changes before approval: `plan.md` still schedules work for Nov 20–22, and the report repeats the Nov 22 deadline. Those dates have passed. Please update the schedule to state what elapsed and was not performed, then identify current next steps. The supplied start pack reports an extension but gives no new date; record that as unverified and the exact deadline as pending confirmation. Do not invent a date.

I reviewed the current head `ec74e5a`, not the older `72734d1` referenced in the PR body. Current-head CI run `44744415490` passed.

Re-reviewed PR #75 at exact head 05134a3e2fac2f10bf2a74f86dc61a8e06cc2310 against the earlier review on ec74e5ac38a706985c4e87a40de96d14414dc111.

The follow-up changes only docs/ai-use.md, docs/labs/lab-06/plan.md, and docs/labs/lab-06/report.md. The elapsed 20–22 November targets are now historical; A’s reported extension is distinguished from official confirmation, and the exact revised deadline remains pending. The report preserves actual/pending distinctions for C/D evidence, Workflow confirmation, availability, acceptance, and submission. I found no blocker in this correction.

Verified required CI run 45404297275 completed successfully on this exact head. A reports 14/14 document checks and 10/10 date assertions; I did not rerun those local checks. Approving this exact head.
